links.outcome: Effect of physician edits to LLM-generated SQL eligibility code on eligibility determinations
links.effect: Physician edits to generated SQL did not change any of 720 trial-patient eligibility determinations for 24 synthetic patients across 30 trials.
links.quote: In physician review of 30 trials, edits to generated SQL did not change any of 720 trial-patient eligibility determinations for 24 synthetic patients.

unlisted_practices: LLM conversion of trial eligibility criteria to SQL for automated trial matching
Blinded physician validation of automated trial eligibility matching

screen.reason: Evaluates an LLM-based system that parses trial eligibility into SQL and matches synthetic cancer patient vignettes against clinical trials, validating accuracy against physician evaluation.
